ravi: Hey folks, hitting a weird one on the Windows/WSL quickstart. Dashboard accepts my token but running the sample in WSL returns an HTML 502. anyone seen this? ravi: Command: `wsl -d ubuntu node quickstart/index.js` (REDWOOD_API_KEY set via Windows env passthrough) ravi: Raw response: ``` HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8

502 Bad Gateway

``` elle: is that a workspace token from the Console or a service key? 502 typically points to a gateway/proxy problem. ravi: workspace token from Settings -> API tokens. I also tried a service key and got 403 inside WSL. From the Windows host curl I get 402 JSON: `\{"error\":\"org_billing_required\",\"help\":\"https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/ravi-test/billing\"\}`. ops-bot: Note: Certain Windows VPN clients and WSL network integrations rewrite or drop Authorization headers. If the Authorization header is removed, the SDK may retry and some gateways respond with HTML 502, which masks upstream JSON errors. ellie: if host curl shows 402 and WSL shows 502, that strongly suggests a network component between WSL and the API removing the header. WSL uses VPN split-tunnel on my machine and we've seen similar behavior. onboard-bot: FYI: Your org (ravi-test) currently has no billing method on file. First outbound requests may be blocked until billing is added: https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/ravi-test/billing :credit_card: ravi: ah okay. dashboard quickstart didn't show a billing modal when I grabbed the token which is confusing — looked like success but runtime calls are gated. ellie: Workarounds: 1) mount a service key file into WSL and set REDWOOD_API_KEY by reading it (`export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat /mnt/c/Users/me/.redwood/service_key)`), 2) run `curl` from host and compare, 3) disable VPN split-tunnel for the test to see if header passthrough is fixed. ravi: mounting the service key file produced the JSON 402 with `org_billing_required`. confirmed it's a header strip issue. ellie: Proposed fixes: - Add a small preflight in the quickstart CLI to check org billing state and print a clear message before making outbound requests. - SDK: detect the known pattern where retries + HTML 502 likely map to missing Authorization and show an actionable hint (map to 402/org_billing_required). - Docs: add Windows/WSL/VPN caveat about Authorization rewrite and recommended secret-file mounts. ops-bot: Suggested ticket fields: repro steps, WSL distro & version, VPN client name, host vs WSL curl outputs, sample quickstart command, and the service key file workaround confirmed. ravi: filing a ticket in eng/devex with logs and the minimal repro now and tagging @elle. thanks for the pointers! :pray:
